description: Form controls for collecting input. This theme restyles Bootstrap 5 form controls: text inputs/selects share a common field treatment (44px tall, 4px radius, gray border that turns primary-blue on focus, light-gray fill when disabled/readonly). Checkboxes, radios and switches use the Bootstrap 5 form-check / form-check-input path (the theme styles these directly, including a danger-bordered required state). Validation uses is-invalid + invalid-feedback. NOTE: legacy BS4 custom-control-* selectors still exist in the SCSS but are residual — prefer the form-check path modeled here.

always: Every text input / select gets `form-control` or `form-select`; every checkbox/radio/switch input gets `form-check-input`.
Pair each control with a `<label>`; use `form-label` for the field label and `form-check-label` for checkbox/radio/switch labels.
Wrap checkbox/radio/switch input+label in a `.form-check` (add `.form-switch` for switches).
Mark a required field's label with `required-field` to render the asterisk.
never: Do not apply `form-control` to a checkbox/radio/switch — use `form-check-input`.
Do not use a CSS class for disabled/readonly/required — use the matching HTML attribute.
Do not add `is-valid` styling for normal fields; the theme strips the green valid treatment, so it has no visual effect.
Do not use the legacy `custom-control-*` / `custom-select` classes for new markup — use the form-check / form-select path.

a11y: Every control needs an associated label: either a `<label for>` matching the control id, or the label wrapping the input.
Set `aria-invalid="true"` on a control showing `is-invalid`, and associate it with the `.invalid-feedback` message via `aria-describedby`.
Group related radios/checkboxes in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`.

control.description: Which kind of form control to render.

text.note: Single/multi-line text, email, number, password, textarea.

checkbox.note: Use on an <input type="checkbox"> inside a .form-check.

radio.note: Use on an <input type="radio"> inside a .form-check.

switch.note: Use on an <input type="checkbox"> inside a .form-check.form-switch.

datepicker.note: Date input styled like a form-select with a calendar affordance.

timepicker.note: Time input styled like a form-select with a clock icon.

size.description: Control height for text inputs / selects. Default (md) is the 44px field; sm is 36px. Append to the control class, e.g. `form-control form-control-sm` or `form-select form-select-lg`.

validation.description: Server-side validation state applied to the control (the theme styles the invalid state; valid is intentionally neutralized).

invalid.note: Red border + attention icon; pair with a sibling .invalid-feedback.

alignment.description: Text alignment of the input value.

right.note: Right-aligns the value, e.g. for currency/amount inputs.

state.description: Interactive state, applied as an HTML attribute (not a class).

required.note: On checkbox/radio/switch this triggers the danger-bordered required treatment; pair the label with .required-field for the visible asterisk.

root.note: Optional wrapper grouping a label, control and feedback. Bootstrap utility margins (mb-*) are an equally valid alternative.

children.note: Field label; add `required-field` to show the required asterisk.
Text-style control; swap for .form-select on a <select>.
Validation message shown when the control has .is-invalid (Bootstrap built-in).
Wrapper for one checkbox/radio/switch; add .form-switch for switches.
